name: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg
kurzbeschreibung: The unique ensemble of castles and fortifications, featuring four defensive structures, impresses with Europe’s longest suspension bridge.
beschreibung: Ehrenberg Castle World – Ehrenberg Castle World is a cultural highlight in **Reutte**, attracting visitors from around the globe. This unique ensemble of four fortifications impresses with Europe’s longest suspension bridge walkway. The exhibition masterfully blends historical heritage with modern storytelling, featuring interactive stations that make the visit thrilling for children and teens alike. A museum shop and café complete the experience. Located right in the heart of **Reutte**, Ehrenberg Castle World is easily accessible on foot or by public transport, making it the perfect starting point for a cultural stroll through the city. Allow plenty of time—the Ehrenberg Castle World will captivate you with its beauty and diversity.
